---
description: "Forms layout containers, child arrangement, sizing, spacing, and alignment"
---

- Forms layouts group overview:
  `include/Pt/Forms/Api-Layouts.h`

  `include/Pt/Forms/Layout.h`
- Position child controls at explicit canvas coordinates:
  `include/Pt/Forms/CanvasLayout.h`
- Dock child controls at edges or fill the available area:
  `include/Pt/Forms/DockingLayout.h`
- Flow child controls horizontally or vertically with wrapping:
  `include/Pt/Forms/FlowLayout.h`
- Arrange child controls in a grid:
  `include/Pt/Forms/GridLayout.h`
- Arrange child controls in table rows and columns:
  `include/Pt/Forms/TableLayout.h`
- Display one child control from a stack:
  `include/Pt/Forms/StackLayout.h`
- Lay out scrollable content:
  `include/Pt/Forms/ScrollLayout.h`
- Select horizontal or vertical layout direction:
  `include/Pt/Forms/Direction.h`
- Align controls within available layout space:
  `include/Pt/Forms/Alignment.h`
- Apply layout adjustments and margins:
  `include/Pt/Forms/Adjustment.h`
- Configure spacing between layout items:
  `include/Pt/Forms/Spacing.h`
